# Biongevity

> Biongevity is a longevity and precision health company. Its clinic in Dubai (Biongevity Precision Health and Longevity Clinic, AB Center, Sheikh Zayed Road, Al Barsha 1) offers dermatology and aesthetic medicine, IV therapy and wellness, general practice and preventive health, longevity and precision health testing, diagnostics and laboratory tests, dental care, home healthcare and telehealth. In the United States, Biongevity plans to launch in March 2027 as an online telehealth service with the Biongevity app (no physical clinic). Other countries: coming soon.

Information on this site is general and educational, not medical advice. In the UAE, in an emergency call 998 (ambulance) or 999.

## Biongevity Dubai (UAE)

- [Biongevity Dubai](https://biongevity.com/uae/): Doctor-led clinic for skin, wellness and longevity in Al Barsha, Dubai. Book on WhatsApp +971 50 528 2566 or call +971 4 379 6393. Prices are shared on WhatsApp; 5% VAT applies.
- [Dermatology & Aesthetic Medicine](https://biongevity.com/uae/dermatology-aesthetics/): HydraFacial, chemical peels, skin boosters, mesotherapy, PRP, exosomes, HIFU, lasers, Botox, fillers, hair and scalp treatments, medical dermatology.
- [IV Therapy & Wellness](https://biongevity.com/uae/iv-therapy-wellness/): IV drips, functional medicine, nutrition, weight management, wellness programmes, vitamin injections.
- [General Practice & Preventive Health](https://biongevity.com/uae/general-practice/): GP consultations, chronic disease management, health checks, women's and men's health assessments, vaccinations.
- [Longevity & Precision Health](https://biongevity.com/uae/longevity-precision-health/): longevity consultation, biological and epigenetic age, whole genome and exome sequencing, pharmacogenomics, microbiome, cell-free DNA.
- [Diagnostics & Laboratory](https://biongevity.com/uae/diagnostics-laboratory/): blood tests and wellness panels, hormone, thyroid, vitamin and mineral testing.
- [Dental Care](https://biongevity.com/uae/dental-care/): dental consultation, scaling and polishing, smile care, family dental package.
- [Home Healthcare](https://biongevity.com/uae/home-healthcare/): doctor and nurse home visits, home blood tests, vital signs, wound care, home IV, post-procedure care.
- [Telehealth](https://biongevity.com/uae/telehealth/): online GP, follow-ups, results reviews, dermatology, women's health and wellness follow-ups.
- [Supplements in the UAE](https://biongevity.com/uae/supplements/): LONgevity+, CellOmega+ (fish-oil version), Creagen.
- [Contact](https://biongevity.com/uae/contact/)
